name: Nitrefazole

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in Germany and Austria, first in 1984 — for blood problems and liver harm

summary: Nitrefazole was removed from the market in Germany and Austria starting in 1984 because of damage to the liver and hematological harm, which means harm to the blood [3]. A small computer model, not tests on real people, gave the drug a high risk score of 91 for the liver [M]. The same computer model also gave it a low risk score of 23 for the heart [M].
